t: This is a memorial plaque at St Bartholomew's Hospital, commemorating Sir William Wallace along with the martyrs memorial. Wallace was a Scottish knight, and one of the main leaders in the First War of Scottish Independence. That is why he is remembered on this spot in London. The material I have here is thin, so I'll say only that the plaque stands as a reminder of his place in Scottish history, and that it is worth pausing to read it.
